_origin: Messages PushSealVectorGenerator (DR-063 draft 1, W1, 2026-11-24): the Java reference of the sealed call push tkm-push/v1 (io.takamaka.messages.call.PushSeal). Construction: design F2_SEALED_CALL_PUSH_DESIGN_2026-11-04 §1.2, one PAD = 2048 (DR-063 §1). Every expected code below was written by hand in the generator and checked against the implementation before rendering.
notes: kid = SHA3-256 (FIPS 202, NOT Keccak-256) over ASCII('tkm-push/v1/kid') (15 bytes, labels.kid_hex) || pkD, truncated to the first 8 bytes. push_key_id (registration echo, DB) = lower hex of kid, 16 characters.

d (keys.*.d_hex) and e (seal_cases[].e_hex) are RAW 32-byte scalars BEFORE clamping; clamping is RFC 7748 §5, inside X25519, on both sides. pkD = X25519(d, 9), epk = X25519(e, 9). d = SHA3-256(ASCII('tkm-push/v1/vectors/device/' + name)), e = SHA3-256(ASCII('tkm-push/v1/vectors/ephemeral/' + case name)).

hdr = 0x01 || kid || epk (41 B); dh = X25519(e, pkD); okm = HKDF-SHA-512(ikm = dh, salt = epk || pkD, info = ASCII('tkm-push/v1/seal'), L = 44) = key 32 || nonce 12; aad = ASCII('tkm-push/v1/aad') || 0x00 || UTF-8(clear type) || 0x00 || hdr; pt = u16be(len J) || J || zeros to 2048; sp = Base64URL(hdr || AES-256-GCM(key, nonce, aad, pt)), '.' padding (2105 bytes -> 2808 chars, exactly one '.').

J = UTF-8 of RFC 8785 JCS of the string map (org.erdtman.jcs.JsonCanonicalizer, the signed path's canonicalizer, also CallRschat.pushRing's). Non-ASCII is raw UTF-8 in J; this file escapes it as \uXXXX at the JSON level only, j_hex is authoritative.

sp decoding: strict Base64URL, the identity decoder (ChatSignatureVerifier.decodeStrictOrNull): URL alphabet only, whole 4-char blocks, '.' padding in the last block only, no whitespace, zero unused bits. '+', '/', '=', a missing '.', any whitespace or newline -> BAD_ENCODING.

Frame parse: strict UTF-8, then one left-to-right JSON parse of ONE top-level object. A repeated top-level key throws DUPLICATE_KEY at once (so it competes with a later syntax error by position); a non-string top-level value is reported as NON_STRING only after a complete, duplicate-free parse; then NOT_JCS (J bytes != JCS of the parsed object), TYPE_MISMATCH (inner type absent or != clear type), BAD_INNER_V (inner v absent or != '1'). Per-type key sets are NOT checked (DR-063 §2).

push key: strict Base64URL ('.' padding) -> BAD_ENCODING; not 32 bytes -> BAD_KEY_LENGTH; bit 255 set (never masked) -> HIGH_BIT; little-endian u >= p = 2^255-19 -> NON_CANONICAL; X25519(low_order_check_scalar, pk) all zero -> LOW_ORDER (any clamped scalar is a multiple of the cofactor 8). The same byte checks run on pkD at seal time.
An open with an all-zero X25519(d, epk) is LOW_ORDER, between KID_MISMATCH and AEAD.
